outcome_detail: Active in Los Angeles Superior Court. In September 2024 a judge agreed to review accused officers' personnel records in chambers; as of March 2025 the City of Los Angeles had denied responsibility and asked the court to shift liability to the Centurions football corporation. No settlement, judgment, or dismissal found in searches through July 2026.
criminal_detail: The LAPD Robbery-Homicide Division conducted a criminal investigation; LAPD officials announced they lacked evidence to present a criminal case against any officers. No charges have been reported.
incident_date_approx: Alleged rookie hazing rituals during Centurions football seasons roughly 2006-2009, including an alleged February 7, 2009 group assault at a team practice
description: Four LAPD officers, suing anonymously as Does, filed a lawsuit in late December 2023 against the City of Los Angeles and the LAPD Centurion Corporation, which runs the department's football team. The suit alleges that rookie players on the Centurions were subjected to ritualized and sexualized hazing between roughly 2006 and 2009, including forced nudity, immersion in ice water, homophobic slurs, and sexual assault; one detective alleges he was stripped and sexually assaulted in front of 30 to 40 officers at a February 2009 practice. The complaint asserts claims including sexual battery, sexual harassment, failure to prevent harassment, retaliation, negligence, negligent hiring and supervision, and infliction of emotional distress. The plaintiffs say they filed anonymously out of fear of retaliation. The city has denied responsibility and sought to shift liability to the Centurions corporation, and the case remained active as of 2025. An LAPD criminal investigation concluded without charges, with officials citing insufficient evidence.
notes: One plaintiff, a detective, filed a precursor legal claim against the city on October 16, 2023 before the consolidated December 2023 lawsuit by the four Doe plaintiffs; treated as a single lawsuit. Accused officers have not been named in cited public reporting, so officer_names is empty.
